title: Dense rollout summary card — stakeholder synthesis & micro-interaction polish
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: Reduce vertical space and cognitive load in the Rollouts list by compressing the summary card while preserving scanability, accessibility, and debugging affordances. Scope covers: compact layout variants for the rollout summary card, focused hover & keyboard interactions, compact state for dense lists, and small-screen adaptations. Rationale: customers with many rollouts (platform teams, enterprises) requested a denser list to scan status and cost signals without losing ability to inspect canary/AB splits. This ticket captures design review outputs, stakeholder feedback, and handoff artifacts for engineering and QA.
acceptance_criteria: Dense variant reduces vertical height >= 30% vs baseline in 1080p view
All interactive controls reachable by keyboard tab order and ARIA labels defined
Color contrast of status chips meets WCAG AA for 14px text
Hover and keyboard focus show same micro-interaction states and do not shift layout
QA verifies no regression in rollout inspection panel expand/collapse behavior
comments: 2026-03-01 - AK: Kickoff review with PM and Eng. Presenting three density treatments: compact, compact+icons, condensed. PM flagged cost-sparkline tradeoffs for very narrow widths — asked to prioritize readability over micro-sparklines.
2026-03-03 - LV (Lead PM): Prefer 'compact+icons' for initial rollout; cost sparklines to be optional via feature flag. Asked design to produce static spec + interactive prototype for dev handoff.

2026-03-04 - ML (Engineering): Raised a perf constraint: continuous sparklines across 200+ rows adds 40% paint cost. Suggested server-side sparklines summarization endpoint or render-as-canvas. Marked ENG-40220 as dependency.

2026-03-05 - Design QA: Ran accessibility audit on compact variant. Found focus outline hidden by card shadow in Firefox; updated focus tokens and added explicit focus ring (outline: 3px solid token-focus).

2026-03-06 - Stakeholder review (Design critique): Noted micro-timing for hover reveals feels slow compared to existing list. Decision: reduce reveal delay from 250ms to 120ms; add instantaneous keyboard reveal for accessibility.
2026-03-08 - PM signoff: Accept compact+icons variant for canary. Requested copy adjustments for rollout status tooltip and an edge case note for archived rollouts.
2026-03-09 - UX Writer: Updated microcopy for rollback button hover state and truncated names tooltip rules. See Drive doc (artifacts).
2026-03-10 - Handoff: Uploaded final spec to Figma and attached CSS token mapping. PRs opened for two small patches (see github_prs). Requested Eng review and QA test plan.
qa_checklist: Verify vertical height reduction percentage on 1080p, 1440p, 4k resolutions
Tab through a dense list of 120 rollouts: focus order consistent; no keyboard traps
Toggle sparklines feature flag: sparklines render/hidden without layout shift
Resize to 720px width: compact variant becomes stacked variant; inspect truncation and tooltip behavior
Screen reader: status chip announced with label and percent change if present
Run automated visual diff for list with and without dense mode to detect regressions
open_questions: Should cost sparklines default to hidden for enterprise orgs with >100 rollouts? (PM asked for metrics-driven decision)
How to expose the density toggle in Console: global setting, per-project, or per-user preference? (needs PM/Eng input)
ENG: preferred implementation approach for sparklines (SVG per-row vs canvas aggregation)
